test (describe > name): ACP effort remains unknown until authoritative session options arrive
invariant: acpHarnessCapabilities reports effortLevels "unresolved" before config options arrive and "unsupported" when the agent sends an empty options list
notes: Effort levels derive from session/new config options; asserts no invented defaults when options are absent vs empty

test (describe > name): ACP effort reports only the selected model without inventing defaults or other model support
invariant: With model+effort select options, effortLevels lists the current model's levels only; child sessions and a missing model option yield "unsupported"/empty
notes: Grouped effort options parsed; child:true forces unsupported; effort option without model option yields unresolved+empty models

test (describe > name): recovery requires a structured missing-resource error identifying this session
invariant: missingAcpSession is true only for a resourceNotFound RequestError naming this session id; string-matching errors, other resources, auth and connection failures are false
notes: Negative cases: internalError w/ matching text, plain Error, missing uri, auth-required, connection-closed all must be false

test (describe > name): reconstruction preserves saved turns but excludes the active prompt and escapes historical content
invariant: renderAcpRecoveryContext emits "User:/Assistant:" lines for saved turns, HTML-escapes </session-context-recovery>, omits the active prompt turn, and does not mutate rows
notes: Assert escaping and active-prompt exclusion in the reconstructed handoff context

test (describe > name): ACP permission grants > an absent kind is remembered as 'other', never as a wildcard
invariant: acpPermissionGrant maps a request with a tool title but no kind to kind "other"
notes: Grant keying: absent kind must not match as wildcard

test (describe > name): ACP permission grants > an untitled request yields no grant, so it can never be answered on the user's behalf
invariant: acpPermissionGrant returns undefined when the tool title is absent or empty
notes: No title means nothing to key a grant on; prevents silent allow-always

test (describe > name): ACP permission grants > a grant matches only the same kind and the same title
invariant: hasAcpGrant is true only for identical kind+tool; different tool string or different kind does not match; empty state has no grant
notes: Exact kind+title matching is the "allow always" scope

test (describe > name): ACP permission grants > saving keeps the rest of the permission state and never duplicates
invariant: withAcpGrant preserves unrelated grant fields (codexCommandGrants), returns identical state on duplicate save, and readAcpGrants lists distinct grants
notes: Dedupe + preservation of sibling grant state

test (describe > name): ACP permission grants > malformed persisted rows are ignored rather than trusted
invariant: readAcpGrants drops null/non-object/missing-tool rows and non-array acpGrants, keeping only well-formed grants
notes: Untrusted persisted state is filtered before use

test (describe > name): ACP native subagent wire contract > requires the published canonical or versioned AIR capability
invariant: supportsACPSubagents is true for sessionCapabilities.subagents or _meta.jetbrains.air v1 with nativeSubagentSessions, false for wrong placement, missing version, or empty-array capability
notes: Capability gate from initialize result; negative shapes must stay false

test (describe > name): ACP native subagent wire contract > admits authoritative identity once and settles the same child
invariant: First subagent_spawned admits provider id "native-child" and allocates child session "claxedo-child"; a replayed spawn returns the same admission; a state_update settles status completed on the same subagentKey/childSessionId with capabilities cancel:false close:false
notes: Replay dedup and stable child-session mapping across spawn->completion; two published events

test (describe > name): ACP native subagent wire contract > does not infer children or controls from tool names and malformed events
invariant: acpSubagentUpdate returns undefined for a Task-named tool_call, empty subagentSessionId, non-boolean capabilities, unknown state; maps cancelled->killed, disconnected->interrupted, failed->failed
notes: ACP session/update variants (tool_call, malformed subagent_spawned/state_update, terminal states) -> subagent observations

test (describe > name): native worker preserves Unicode, lookaround, backreferences and substring matching
invariant: The elicitation pattern evaluator treats patterns as unanchored substring matches with full JS regex semantics (unicode, lookaround, backrefs); "." does not match "\r"; a bad pattern is invalid_schema
notes: Form validation semantics: substring matching, code points for emoji, invalid_answer vs invalid_schema error codes

test (describe > name): Node and Bun terminate catastrophic native regex under an external watchdog
invariant: A worker thread running catastrophic regex on 100k chars can still be terminated while the event loop stays responsive, on both node and bun
notes: Subprocess-based fault injection; the test is a watchdog over worker.terminate(), not reachable by a flow

test (describe > name): timeout and cancellation release the bounded worker slot
invariant: A 10ms deadline turns a catastrophic regex into validation_timeout, an aborted signal rejects, and the pool slot is released so a later healthy validation succeeds
notes: Bounded-pool slot release under timeout+cancel; plan keeps elicitation validation races as focused tests

test (describe > name): errorMessage > the RequestError premise: it is an Error subclass whose detail lives in .data
invariant: RequestError is both an Error and carries object data while .message is the fixed code name, so errorMessage must check data before instanceof Error
notes: JSON-RPC error input premise; guards the ordering that keeps agent detail from collapsing to "Internal error"

test (describe > name): errorMessage > a plain Error keeps its message
invariant: errorMessage(new Error("spawn ENOENT")) returns "spawn ENOENT"
notes: Non-RPC error input -> unchanged message in surfaced error text

test (describe > name): errorMessage > an agent's data.details surfaces instead of only the JSON-RPC code name
invariant: errorMessage(RequestError.internalError({details: stderr})) returns "Internal error: <stderr>"
notes: Agent failure carrying data.details -> "code name: detail"

test (describe > name): errorMessage > agents that put their detail in data.message surface that instead
invariant: errorMessage({code:-32603, data:{message:"model unavailable"}}) returns "Internal error: model unavailable"
notes: data.message variant of agent error detail

test (describe > name): errorMessage > a top-level message that differs from the detail is composed with it
invariant: errorMessage({message:"Invalid params", data:{details:"cwd must be absolute"}}) returns "Invalid params: cwd must be absolute"
notes: Composition rule when top-level and detail differ

test (describe > name): errorMessage > a top-level message equal to the detail is not duplicated
invariant: errorMessage({message:"disk full", data:{details:"disk full"}}) returns "disk full"
notes: Dedup rule when message equals detail

test (describe > name): errorMessage > a bare JSON-RPC object with no data uses its message
invariant: errorMessage({code:-32601, message:"Method not found"}) returns "Method not found"
notes: Error object without data -> message only

test (describe > name): errorMessage > a non-object is stringified
invariant: errorMessage("connection reset")/null/undefined return "connection reset"/"null"/"undefined"
notes: Non-object error inputs stringify

test (describe > name): ACP transport environment > scrubs the local document installation secret from the child environment
invariant: acpSpawnEnv drops CLAXEDO_LOCAL_DOCUMENT_BROKER_TOKEN while preserving the rest of the environment
notes: Scripted command agent can echo its env; the broker token must be absent from the spawned harness's environment

test (describe > name): ACP connection transport > validates exact process, streamable HTTP, and WebSocket descriptors
invariant: validateACPConnection accepts and round-trips process{command,args}, streamable-http{https url}, and websocket{wss url} descriptors
notes: Positive descriptor shapes for both command and websocket connects in H16

test (describe > name): ACP connection transport > filesystem reachability is an explicit assertion independent of transport
invariant: sharedFilesystem defaults undefined, passes through true/false for all three kinds, and a non-boolean value throws
notes: sharedFilesystem flag validation per connection kind

test (describe > name): ACP connection transport > rejects aliases, mixed local/remote fields, and missing authorities
invariant: Validation throws for process without command, process+url, remote/http kinds, missing url, and cross-protocol urls
notes: Negative descriptor cases: alias kinds (remote/http), mixed fields, unsupported url protocols

test (describe > name): immediate adapter recreation waits for the old wrapper's resistant writer child
invariant: Disposing an adapter and immediately creating a session on a second adapter blocks until the old process's SIGTERM-ignoring writer child is proven dead
notes: Retirement fence: recreation must wait on the old process tree; plan keeps descendant retirement as a focused test (skipped on win32)

test (describe > name): a launch whose creation identity was never established is reported as unavailable
invariant: A spawn that never produces a pid leaves readRuntimeHealth at {status:"unavailable", reason:"harness_retirement_unresolved"} after createSession rejects
notes: Failed-launch variant of custom ACP by command; health read must say unavailable, not a plain process loss

test (describe > name): invalidated session owner keys are not reused by read-only capability lookup
invariant: After session->process bindings are forgotten, entryForSession is undefined, readConnectionState reports "configured", and keyForSession mints a new key instead of reusing the retired one
notes: Post-restart binding invalidation: read-only lookups must not resurrect retired owner keys

test (describe > name): synchronous onError preserves launch failure and retires its transport
invariant: When the transport factory calls onError synchronously, initialize() rejects with "original launch failure", the death callback fires once, and the transport is disposed once
notes: Fault injected synchronously inside the factory; ordering of reject->death->dispose not reachable by a flow

test (describe > name): synchronous onExit preserves launch failure and retires its transport
invariant: When the transport factory calls onExit(17) synchronously, initialize() rejects mentioning 17, death fires once, transport disposed once
notes: Same invariant via the onExit path

test (describe > name): cancelling an intermediate child settles only its descendant interactions
invariant: cancel("child") resolves pending permissions and elicitations for exactly that subtree (child+grandchild, not root/sibling); a failing store write in cancelPendingPermissions throws before any settlement
notes: Descendant-scoped cancel plus a fault-injected appendEvent failure that must leave all pending state untouched

test (describe > name): a synchronous error followed by constructor failure does not schedule death callbacks
invariant: If the factory calls onError and then throws, the constructor throws the factory error and no death callback is ever scheduled
notes: onError-then-throw race inside construction; death callback must not fire

test (describe > name): generateAcpTitle > returns the temp session's reply text without touching the store
invariant: Title generation boots a temp session (no preset name), prompts it with the conversation text, and concatenates agent_message_chunk deltas into the returned title
notes: Temp-session naming; asserts boot title arg undefined and reply text "Add tests" from streamed chunks

test (describe > name): generateAcpTitle > prompt timeout cancels the temporary title session and yields null
invariant: When the title prompt exceeds CLAXEDO_ACP_NEW_SESSION_TIMEOUT_MS the temp session is cancelled and the result is null
notes: Scripted agent that never replies; asserts cancel reaches the temp session

test (describe > name): AcpHarnessAdapter.listAgents > returns live process agents before probing
invariant: With a live process, listAgents returns the agent's own getAgents() list without probing config options
notes: Live agent list takes precedence over probe

test (describe > name): AcpHarnessAdapter.listAgents > lists probed ACP agents before any session exists
invariant: With no live process, listAgents derives agents from a probed "mode" select option's choices
notes: Probe path: mode config option -> agent list entries

test (describe > name): AcpHarnessAdapter.listAgents > rejects when probing finds no ACP modes
invariant: With no live process and no mode option, listAgents rejects "ACP harness did not return live agent options"
notes: Negative: agent without a mode selector

test (describe > name): AcpHarnessAdapter.probeConfigOptions > uses the session boot timeout when no probe timeout override is set
invariant: A probe whose shared process never finishes startup rejects with "ACP mode probe timed out", using CLAXEDO_ACP_NEW_SESSION_TIMEOUT_MS when CLAXEDO_ACP_PROBE_TIMEOUT_MS is unset
notes: Timeout source fallback order is the invariant; a flow can only see the eventual error, not which clock fired

test (describe > name): AcpHarnessAdapter.probeConfigOptions > rejects when shared process startup hangs
invariant: A hanging getOrSpawnProbe rejects probeConfigOptions with "ACP mode probe timed out" under CLAXEDO_ACP_PROBE_TIMEOUT_MS
notes: Fault-injected hang; asserts the probe can't block a caller forever

test (describe > name): AcpHarnessAdapter.probeConfigOptions > returns cached options from the shared process without booting
invariant: When the shared probe process already holds cachedConfigOptions, probeConfigOptions returns them without calling getOrSpawnProbe
notes: Repeated probing must reuse one probe process (observable as a single spawned agent)

test (describe > name): createStdioACPTransport through a real .cmd launcher on native Windows > a launcher in a path with a space delivers every argument literally, with no shell in between
invariant: Spawning a .cmd shim whose directory contains a space delivers the argv array (metacharacters, quotes, spaces) verbatim to the child with exit code 0
notes: Windows lane: argv integrity through .cmd launcher, no shell interpretation

test (describe > name): createStdioACPTransport through a real .cmd launcher on native Windows > a bare launcher name resolves through the configured PATH from an unrelated directory
invariant: A bare "agent.cmd" command resolves via the env PATH while cwd is an unrelated directory, and argv arrives verbatim
notes: Windows PATH resolution of bare launcher names

test (describe > name): createStdioACPTransport through a real .cmd launcher on native Windows > a launcher that names no executable is refused before anything runs
invariant: An unresolvable command throws "does not resolve to a real executable" synchronously and the shim's marker proves its body never ran
notes: Refusal must precede any shell execution (marker file stays absent)

test (describe > name): a Goal projection that finalizes cleanly releases the session
invariant: finishGoalProjection clears the turn authority and the busy section so the session admits a new turn
notes: After a goal turn ends the session must accept another turn

test (describe > name): a Goal terminal the store refuses still leaves the session admissible
invariant: When finishTurn throws, finishGoalProjection still releases the busy section, leaves the session admissible, and reports the refusal once via reportOwnerFailure
notes: Fault-injected store refusal; lease release and error reporting under a failed write

test (describe > name): a Goal projection whose turn could not start does not keep the session's lease
invariant: When startTurn throws, startGoalProjection propagates, leaves no turn authority, no busy lease, and reports the failure once
notes: Fault-injected startTurn refusal; a retained lease would block the session forever

test (describe > name): negotiated children traverse ACP wire and isolated child transcripts
invariant: subagent_spawned/state_update updates create real child sessions with isolated stored transcripts; a late child after parent completion gets its own session; a child's permission request surfaces on the root session; disconnect marks it interrupted; resume does not duplicate the child
notes: Rich case: child+grandchild session tree, transcript isolation, post-completion spawn, child permission routed to root session, disconnect->interrupted, resume dedup

test (describe > name): subagent negotiation=true rejects spoofed lineage without losing the connection
invariant: With negotiated subagent capability, session/updates claiming a child of another root or a cyclic spawn are dropped, exactly the 2 legitimate events are delivered, and the process stays alive
notes: ACP session/update inputs with spoofed/cyclic lineage; asserts filtered observation stream and rootAgentSessionId mapping

test (describe > name): ACP elicitation > durably presents a typed form, validates without consuming it, and replies exactly once
invariant: elicitation/create with a form persists a custom question; a missing-required-field reply throws without consuming it; a reply from a foreign session throws; a valid reply resolves {action:"accept",content} once, emits question.asked then question.replied, clears the row, and a second reply throws
notes: Asserts event order question.asked->question.replied and once-only settlement; foreign-session reply refused

test (describe > name): ACP elicitation > distinguishes decline, dismissal, and process loss
invariant: reject() resolves {action:"decline"}, an empty-answer reply resolves {action:"cancel"}, and an aborted signal resolves {action:"cancel"}
notes: Three distinct settlement kinds: decline, cancel-by-empty-reply, cancel-by-abort

test (describe > name): ACP elicitation > URL acceptance is consent only and URL IDs remain outstanding until completion
invariant: URL mode rejects an arbitrary "done" answer requiring explicit consent text; duplicate elicitationId throws until complete() runs; dispose cancels an outstanding URL elicitation
notes: URL consent requires the consent phrase; elicitationId dedup until completion

test (describe > name): ACP elicitation > rejects unsupported modes, nested forms and active-content URLs without persisting a question
invariant: Unknown modes, javascript: URLs, and nested-object form schemas throw at create and leave no stored question
notes: Untrusted elicitation params: nothing persists on rejection

test (describe > name): pattern mismatch and timeout preserve the durable question for a valid retry
invariant: An invalid_answer and a validation_timeout reply both reject without consuming the stored question, and a later valid reply settles accept
notes: Failed validation is retryable; the question survives mismatch and timeout (timeout half is the race-prone part)

test (describe > name): question cancellation defeats an in-flight validation and duplicate acceptance
invariant: A concurrent reply during validation rejects validation_busy; disposing mid-validation rejects the in-flight reply validation_cancelled and settles the agent's promise as cancel
notes: Plan keeps elicitation validation races; concurrent reply + dispose-during-validation interleaving

test (describe > name): invalid pattern schema never publishes a question
invariant: elicitation/create with an uncompilable pattern rejects invalid_schema and emits no question.asked event
notes: Schema validated before any durable write or event

test (describe > name): ACP shared question settlement retains its live resolver after a failed durable reply
invariant: When appendEvent throws during reply, the reply rejects but the question stays owned and listed; a retry after the write heals settles accept
notes: Fault-injected store write; resolver must survive the failed durable reply

test (describe > name): real ACP JSON-RPC elicitation persists a form and returns accepted content
invariant: An elicitation/create request over the real JSON-RPC stream persists a question; replyQuestion resolves the request with {action:"accept", content} and clears the row
notes: Wire-level roundtrip: request id answered with accept+content

test (describe > name): request-scoped elicitation uses an actual outstanding prompt ID and rejects unknown IDs
invariant: elicitation/create with an unknown requestId gets -32602; one scoped to a live prompt id persists; after the turn ends the same requestId is again -32602
notes: Request-scoped elicitations valid only while that prompt request is outstanding

test (describe > name): a sibling adapter cannot retire a live question, but disposal clears the pending row
invariant: A second adapter's listQuestions neither lists nor retires another adapter's live question; disposing the owner clears the durable row
notes: Two live owners on one store; only the resolver owner may settle/retire its question

test (describe > name): a cold adapter retires durable questions whose process resolver was lost
invariant: A fresh adapter listing questions retires a persisted question whose owning process is gone, and replying to it throws "no longer connected"
notes: Post-restart: orphaned durable questions are retired on read and unanswerable

test (describe > name): stopping a parent cancels descendant elicitations and preserves another session's question
invariant: Cancelling the root session's turn sends {action:"cancel"} replies to its child and grandchild elicitations while a sibling session's question is untouched
notes: Stop scoped to the cancelled subtree; asserts sibling session's pending question survives

test (describe > name): the model an ACP agent resolved for itself > clears probe discovery when the agent explicitly returns no options or model
invariant: A second session/new returning empty configOptions and null models clears the cached resolved model for that session while the earlier session keeps its own
notes: Per-session discovery cache: empty answer clears only the answering session

test (describe > name): the model an ACP agent resolved for itself > reaches the config-options payload when the agent reports a current model
invariant: session/new with models.currentModelId matching availableModels yields peekConfigOptions/probeConfigOptions carrying resolvedModel {id,name}
notes: resolvedModel from agent-reported currentModelId

test (describe > name): the model an ACP agent resolved for itself > carries no model field when the agent reports live options and no model
invariant: With configOptions but no models block, the probe payload has options and no resolvedModel key at all
notes: Absence of resolvedModel (key absent, not null) when agent reports none

test (describe > name): the model an ACP agent resolved for itself > carries no model field when the agent names a model it never described
invariant: A currentModelId absent from availableModels yields no resolvedModel in the payload
notes: Undescribed current model id is not reported as resolved

test (describe > name): the model an ACP agent resolved for itself > reads the model config option when that is the channel the agent speaks
invariant: A category:"model" select option's currentValue resolves to {id,name} from that option's own choices
notes: Fallback channel: model select option supplies the resolved model

test (describe > name): observations fence old generations, isolate directories, and never promote discovery readiness
invariant: Stale-generation writes are ignored after a newer begin(); a probe's "ready" never promotes connection state; directories are isolated until associate(); a disposed process reads disconnected and later writes are inert
notes: Generation fencing and probe-vs-execution channels are ordering invariants flows can't interleave deterministically

test (describe > name): read-only adapter state observes real wire handshake, auth, loss and retirement without probe sessions
invariant: readConnectionState moves configured->connecting->ready (or auth-required on -32000) driven by the real handshake; per-session reads work; stream close -> disconnected; dispose -> configured with the process row "disconnected"; no probe launches
notes: Asserts launches()==1 (reads never spawn), auth-required on session/new -32000, and retired process observed "disconnected" under a "configured" connection

test (describe > name): launch and initialization failures remain observed failures
invariant: A throwing transport factory or a failing initialize reply both reject createSession and leave readConnectionState "failed"
notes: Two failure kinds (spawn throw, initialize error) -> observed failed state

test (describe > name): handshake timeout reports a failed generation
invariant: A scripted agent that never answers initialize rejects createSession "timed out" and leaves readConnectionState failed with process reason initialize_timeout
notes: Hung-initialize variant of the scripted agent; user-visible failed/initialize_timeout

test (describe > name): one reused process is observed in each directory it actually serves
invariant: A shared process keyed by owner serves two directories: one launch total, and both directories read "ready" with the same generation
notes: Shared process observed under each directory it serves, single launch

test (describe > name): reading ACP permission modes > config options are read, with the agent's own names
invariant: permissionModes derives the mode list, names and currentModeId from a category:"mode" select option and reports appliesFrom "next-turn"
notes: Agent's own mode ids/names surface verbatim; timing is next-turn

test (describe > name): reading ACP permission modes > grouped select options are flattened rather than missed
invariant: A mode option whose options are groups yields the flattened mode ids from every group
notes: SessionConfigSelectOptions union: grouped shape must not read as empty

test (describe > name): reading ACP permission modes > an option is found by category even when its id is something else
invariant: The mode option is located by category:"mode" even when its id is "permission-profile"
notes: Category match, not id match, finds the mode option

test (describe > name): reading ACP permission modes > the legacy set_mode channel is used when there are no config options
invariant: With no config options, permissionModes reads modes/availableModes+currentModeId from the legacy set_mode channel
notes: Legacy channel fallback for agents without config options

test (describe > name): reading ACP permission modes > does not infer semantic permission levels from opaque mode ids
invariant: Every reported mode has level undefined; mode ids like "bypassPermissions" are never mapped to semantic levels
notes: No semantic-level inference from opaque ids

test (describe > name): reading ACP permission modes > no channel at all reads as unsupported, not as empty
invariant: An agent with neither config options nor modes reports unsupported; an agent with a channel that reported nothing is empty-but-supported
notes: unsupported vs empty distinction must survive

test (describe > name): writing an ACP permission mode > a config-option write sends set_config_option with the option's own id
invariant: setPermissionMode issues one session/set_config_option with {sessionId, configId:"mode", value} and reports the response's currentModeId
notes: Wire shape of the config-option write path

test (describe > name): writing an ACP permission mode > the returned option list replaces the stored one rather than merging
invariant: A set_config_option response with a shrunken options list replaces the stored list; dropped modes stay gone
notes: Replacement semantics: agent's refreshed list wins

test (describe > name): writing an ACP permission mode > a clamped answer is reported, not the requested id
invariant: When the agent's response reports a different currentValue than requested, the result reports the agent's value
notes: Agent-clamped mode is reported honestly

test (describe > name): writing an ACP permission mode > the legacy channel sends set_mode
invariant: With only the legacy channel, setPermissionMode sends session/set_mode {sessionId, modeId} and reports the requested id pending later sync
notes: Legacy set_mode wire shape

test (describe > name): writing an ACP permission mode > an unknown mode id throws instead of being sent
invariant: A mode id the agent never offered rejects "does not offer" on both channels and no request is sent
notes: Never forward an unadvertised mode; zero requests on refusal

test (describe > name): currentModeId survives merges > it is taken from the agent's payload, not carried over blindly
invariant: Each session state merge takes currentModeId from that payload's modes block
notes: Mode sync follows the latest agent payload

test (describe > name): currentModeId survives merges > a merge that carries no modes leaves the current one alone
invariant: A merge whose payload lacks modes keeps the previous currentModeId
notes: Unrelated updates must not clear the mode

test (describe > name): currentModeId survives merges > an agent-initiated mode change synchronizes the id without dropping the list
invariant: An agent-initiated current_mode_update changes currentModeId while preserving the available modes order
notes: Agent-side mode switch propagates to the picker

test (describe > name): selectPermissionOption — exact matches > each decision takes its own kind when the agent offers it
invariant: allow_once/allow_always/deny/reject_always map to same-named kinds, with deny mapping to reject_once
notes: Decision->kind mapping incl. deny->reject_once

test (describe > name): selectPermissionOption — exact matches > returns the agent's own optionId, not the kind
invariant: The reply carries the agent's optionId (e.g. "cursor-opt-7"), not the kind string
notes: Reply must use agent-assigned optionId

test (describe > name): selectPermissionOption — narrowing a grant is allowed > allow_always degrades to allow_once when the agent has no always option
invariant: With only allow_once+reject_once offered, an allow_always decision answers allow_once
notes: Narrowing a grant is permitted

test (describe > name): selectPermissionOption — narrowing a grant is allowed > reject_always degrades to reject_once
invariant: reject_always falls back to reject_once when that is all the agent offers
notes: Narrowing a rejection is permitted

test (describe > name): selectPermissionOption — widening a GRANT is forbidden > allow_once never escalates to allow_always
invariant: With only allow_always offered, an allow_once decision yields no selectable option
notes: Security: "once" never widens to "always"; refusal must be expressible

test (describe > name): selectPermissionOption — widening a GRANT is forbidden > allow_once yields nothing rather than any allow it can find
invariant: allow_once with only allow_always+reject_always offered is undefined, not the nearest allow
notes: No fuzzy allow matching

test (describe > name): selectPermissionOption — widening a DENIAL is fail-safe > deny escalates to reject_always when reject_once is absent
invariant: deny answers reject_always when only that rejection kind exists
notes: A broader "no" is still a "no"; cancelling would let the agent retry

test (describe > name): selectPermissionOption — widening a DENIAL is fail-safe > deny prefers reject_once when both are present
invariant: deny prefers reject_once over reject_always when both exist
notes: Narrowest sufficient denial first

test (describe > name): selectPermissionOption — nothing acceptable > an empty option list yields undefined for every decision
invariant: Every decision returns undefined against an empty option list
notes: Agent offering nothing cannot be auto-answered

test (describe > name): selectPermissionOption — nothing acceptable > an allow decision never falls through to a reject option
invariant: Allow decisions never select reject kinds
notes: No allow->reject fallthrough

test (describe > name): selectPermissionOption — nothing acceptable > a deny decision never falls through to an allow option
invariant: Deny decisions never select allow kinds
notes: No deny->allow fallthrough

test (describe > name): selectPermissionOption — nothing acceptable > unknown kinds the agent invents are ignored
invariant: Options with invented kinds are never selected
notes: Untrusted option kinds filtered

test (describe > name): permissionOptionPreference > every decision has at least one acceptable kind, most-preferred first
invariant: permissionOptionPreference returns a non-empty deduplicated preference list for all four decisions
notes: Preference-order contract the selector walks

test (describe > name): permissionOptionPreference > no preference list mixes allow and reject kinds
invariant: Allow-side decisions list only allow kinds; deny-side only reject kinds
notes: Preference lists never cross the allow/reject boundary

test (describe > name): acpPermissionRequest — the classification, not the prose > permission is the ToolKind, never the human title
invariant: request_permission params produce permission equal to the ACP kind ("read"), not the tool title
notes: session/request_permission input -> permission request; policy keys on kind

test (describe > name): acpPermissionRequest — the classification, not the prose > the human title is preserved in metadata rather than discarded
invariant: The tool title lands in metadata {title, reason} for both execute and read kinds
notes: Title preserved as display metadata

test (describe > name): acpPermissionRequest — the classification, not the prose > an absent kind becomes 'other', which is never auto-approved
invariant: A request without kind classifies as permission "other"
notes: Fail-safe: unclassified -> "other", never auto-approvable

test (describe > name): acpPermissionRequest — the classification, not the prose > every ToolKind round-trips unchanged into permission
invariant: All ten ACP ToolKinds pass through to permission unchanged
notes: Full ToolKind enum coverage

test (describe > name): acpPermissionRequest — the classification, not the prose > paths flow to both patterns and always; ids are passed through
invariant: toolCall paths populate patterns and always; permId/sessionId become id/sessionID
notes: Field mapping of the request payload

test (describe > name): ACP first-party MCP injection > session/new carries the user's servers plus the claxedo entry for the session it opens
invariant: Each session/new sends user MCP servers plus a session-scoped claxedo entry whose URL and bearer name that session
notes: Local half of H-1: per-session bearer injection; H24's remote run asserts the same entry never leaves the machine

test (describe > name): ACP first-party MCP injection > session/fork names the forked session, not the parent
invariant: forkSession sends the claxedo entry scoped to the child's session id, not the parent's
notes: Fork path re-scopes the bearer to the child session

test (describe > name): ACP first-party MCP injection > a caller that names no session opens the session with the user's servers only
invariant: newSession without a session name sends only user MCP servers, no claxedo entry
notes: No bearer is injected when nothing names a session (e.g. probes)

test (describe > name): ACP adapter first-party MCP end to end > createSession sends session/new with the claxedo entry naming that session and carrying its bearer
invariant: Through applyConfig+createSession over a scripted transport, session/new carries [user servers, claxedo session-scoped entry with Authorization bearer]

test (describe > name): AcpHarnessAdapter > clears a persisted permission reply even after reload lost the live ACP process
invariant: Responding to a persisted permission whose owning process is gone still appends permission.replied for that request
notes: Post-restart orphaned permission replies still commit

test (describe > name): AcpHarnessAdapter > hides orphaned ACP permissions after reload without mutating during list
invariant: listPermissions returns only permissions held by a live process; the orphan is hidden and the read performs no stale/recovering writes
notes: Orphaned pending requests hidden on read; list must not mutate

test (describe > name): AcpHarnessAdapter > fails the turn instead of hanging forever when cold-start resume stalls
invariant: A resumeSession that never settles ends the turn with session.error under the new-session timeout
notes: Gated-promise fault; bounded turn failure instead of a hang

test (describe > name): AcpHarnessAdapter > fails the turn instead of hanging forever when cold-start sync stalls
invariant: A syncSession that never settles ends the turn with session.error under the timeout
notes: Same invariant at the sync stage
